claim: SCORP moves the shared slot 12 only while its picture is a LIVE scorpion, the band 0x30-0x33: :2007-2008 "CMP I,30 / BCS 50$" enters the move code for 0x30 and up, while :2003-2004 "CMP I,34 / BCC 2$" sends 0x34 and above to the explosion handler. So isScorpion(pic) is 0x30 <= pic < 0x34.

corroboration.note: CMP I,34 draws the exploding boundary one above the top scorpion picture 0x33.

claim: A scorpion may START only from the PARKED slot: :2009-2012 "LDA ANTV / EOR CKF8 / CMP I,0F8 / BCC 3$" branches away (an ant is already in flight) whenever ANTV is below 0xF8, so the spawn gate requires ANTV >= 0xF8.

corroboration.note: The FRAME test at :2013-2014 is the next gate once the slot is confirmed parked.

claim: The scorpion spawn gate reads CENTIN as DECIMAL 11 (:2017-2020 "LDA CENTIN-1 / CMP I,11.") — one lower than the flea's decimal 12 — so scorpions appear only once the centipede has been worn down further than the flea requires.

corroboration.note: CMP I,11. carries a trailing period (decimal); BCS 3$ holds the scorpion out at or above 11.

claim: The spawn is attempted only on a FRAME whose LOW byte is zero: :2013-2014 "LDA FRAME / BEQ 4$" reads the low byte of the 2-byte FRAME counter (CENDE4.MAC:125 "FRAME: .BLKB 2"), so a spawn window opens once every 256 frames.

corroboration.note: LDA FRAME loads the low byte; BEQ 4$ takes the spawn path only when it is 0.

claim: The scorpion enters on a 1-in-4 rng roll: :2021-2023 "LDA RNGEN / AND I,03 / BNE 3$" rejects three RNGEN values in four before a scorpion is started.

corroboration.note: LDA RNGEN supplies the byte AND I,03 masks; BNE 3$ rejects a non-zero result.

claim: The crossing speed is chosen off the score: below 20,000 (SCORE2 < 2, :2029-2030 "CMP I,2") the magnitude is 1 (:2041 "LDA I,1"); at or above 20,000 it is 2 (:2035 "LDA I,2") UNLESS a 1-in-4 rng roll keeps it slow (:2032-2034 "AND I,03 / BEQ 5$"). The direction is RNGEN bit 7 (:2036/:2042 "BIT RNGEN / BPL", negating to -magnitude when the bit is set).

corroboration.note: BIT RNGEN / BPL 10$ keeps the positive magnitude; the fall-through LDA I,-N negates it.

claim: A started scorpion begins at the screen edge and walks flat: :2046-2047 "LDA I,0 / STA ANTH ;START AT EDGE" and :2048 "STA ANTDV ;CLEAR VERTICAL DIRECTION" — ANTH=0, ANTDV=0, so the scorpion never descends.

corroboration.note: STA ANTDV clears the vertical step immediately after ANTH is zeroed.

claim: The scorpion's row is drawn from RNGEN into the upper half: :2049-2054 "LDA RNGEN / AND I,78 / CLC / ADC I,70 / ... / STA ANTV" gives ANTV = (RNGEN & 0x78) + 0x70, i.e. a multiple of 8 in [0x70, 0xE8] — always on screen, never at the 0xF8 park.

corroboration.note: ADC I,70 biases the masked RNGEN into the upper-half band.

claim: The crossing is horizontal only: upright (CKC0=0) :2065-2067 "CLC / ADC ANTDH / STA ANTH" adds ANTDH to ANTH each frame, and ANTV is never touched by the move code.

corroboration.note: STA ANTH stores the new horizontal position produced by ADC ANTDH.

claim: The scorpion re-parks the instant ANTH returns to 0: :2069 "BNE 60$" continues the crossing while ANTH is non-zero, and the fall-through :2070/:2075 "BEQ 58$ / 58$ JMP ANTPC" runs the SAME ANTPC re-park the flea uses, drawing a fresh column.

source.verbatim: 58$:	JMP ANTPC		;RESET ENTRY TO ALLOW ANTS

corroboration.note: BNE 60$ / BEQ 58$ split on ANTH: zero routes to JMP ANTPC.

claim: The scorpion picture cycles by a GENUINE +1 every four frames: :2077-2078 "LDA FRAME / AND I,03 / BNE 70$" gates the change, and :2080-2085 "LDA ANTP / CLC / ADC I,01 / AND I,03 / ORA I,30" adds one and wraps within 0x30-0x33 — unlike the flea's INC-then-ADC +2, so all four SCORP pictures are reachable.

corroboration.note: AND I,03 on FRAME gates the change to every fourth frame; the +1 has no prior memory INC.

claim: Every normal mushroom the scorpion passes is poisoned: :2090-2096 "CMP I,40 / BCS 90$ / CMP I,3C / BCC 90$ / AND I,0FB / ... / STA NY,OBST" poisons a cell in [0x3C, 0x40) by clearing bit 2, mapping 0x3C-0x3F onto the 0x38-0x3B band (cp1-4's PM-19). Empty, non-mushroom and already-poisoned cells fall through untouched.

corroboration.note: CMP I,3C / BCC 90$ excludes already-poisoned and empty cells; CMP I,40 excludes non-mushrooms.

claim: SHOOT scores the shared slot as a SCORPION when its picture is 0x20 or above: :2213-2216 "LDA X,MOBJP / EOR CKC0 / CMP I,20 / BCS 131$" routes past the flea's two-hit branch straight to the scorpion's single-hit 131$.

corroboration.note: The same band split at :2192 sent the scorpion past the flea's speed-dependent V window to the generic 12$.

claim: The scorpion's shot windows are the generic V window 5 (:2202 "CPY I,5") and a WIDER decimal-10 H window (:2226 "CPY I,10.") — a hit needs |dV| < 5 and |dH| < 10.

corroboration.note: CPY I,10. is decimal (trailing period); CPY I,5 is the generic vertical window the scorpion inherits.

claim: A scorpion is worth 1000 points for a single hit: :2228 "LDY I,10" loads the SCORN1 high byte as HEX 0x10, which the BCD score routine reads as the decimal digits 1,0 -> 1000. There is no two-hit path (129$ jumps straight to 18$).

corroboration.note: 18$ STY TEMP1 takes Y (0x10) as the MSB of the score passed to SCORN1.

claim: A killed scorpion takes the SHARED 0xFF explosion picture: :2301-2302 "LDA I,0FF / STA X,MOBJP ;EXPLOSION PICTURE" — the same byte a killed flea or segment takes, which EXPLOD counts down and SCORP (:2072-2075) re-parks. A slot parked off the top (ANTV >= 0xF8) is not shootable (:2180-2182).

corroboration.note: STA X,MOBJP writes 0xFF into slot 12; the shared EXPLOD/ANTPC path revives it (cp3-2).
